# exo_intra_organization_connector (Data Source)

Look up an existing IntraOrganizationConnector object. Set identity or name to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Read-Only

- `discovery_endpoint` (String) Maps to the -DiscoveryEndpoint parameter.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -Enabled parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `target_address_domains` (String) Maps to the -TargetAddressDomains parameter.
